title: Employment Screening Process for Foreigners Applying for Work Permit
what_it_is: Employment Screening Process for Foreigners Applying for Work Permit

sections.label: Foreigner work permit screening
sections.summary: Screening of work permit applicants helps minimise undesirable persons working in Singapore, with around 8,400 rejected yearly on average between 2016 and 2018.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) what is the employment screening process for foreigners applying for a work permit; and (b) in the past three years, how many applicants have been rejected because of their unsatisfactory records.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This screening of applicants helps to minimise incidence where undesirable persons are inadvertently allowed to work in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2016 and 2018, around 8,400 applicants were rejected per year, on average, as a result of this screening.

sections.label: Adverse records and employer appeals
sections.summary: Foreigners who infringed MOM regulations have adverse records marked, and employers may appeal or blacklist them for such conduct.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Generally, as part of policy, as foreigners who have infringed MOM's regulations, they will have their adverse record marked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For this case, if the maids' employers want to appeal, they can certainly appeal, but I am not sure if the Member is asking for them to return, or she wants them black-listed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, I suppose the employers also have an option to blacklist them as well for such adverse conduct, for example, that they want MOM to take note of.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We will certainly take note and mark it in the list.

sections.label: Unlicensed moneylending adverse conduct
sections.summary: Unlicensed moneylending is adverse conduct that goes into the record without the employer needing to report it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: When I talk about adverse conduct, when we talk about moneylending, it applies to unlicensed moneylending.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: If it is unlicensed, certainly, that is adverse conduct and so, it will go into the record without the need for the employer to report this.
